what_this_is: One entry per system that scores, ranks, lists, or monitors x402 endpoints or MCP servers - the outreach register for the note on the desk. Facts only, and nothing here is typed twice: registry/scorers-outreach.md is rendered from this file by npm run outreach:build, the test fails when the two disagree, and npm run outreach:check reads every url here for one of our row URLs or the cite_json shape. Alphabetical by name, never a priority order.
the_note: The note to send is the one on the desk under 'For scorers and marketplaces'; it is never rewritten here or anywhere else in this tree. note_sent records the date the keeper says he sent it, and only then - the register never marks a note sent on its own.
the_fields: name, url, what_it_scores (one sentence), contact (the address or form their own site gives, or null), found_on (where we learned of them), note_sent (date or null), reply (null, or one sentence with a date), cites_since (null until their page carries one of our ROW URLs - a verify URL, a numbered corpus entry, a host history, a round - or the cite_json shape).
